title: 第3章 让你失望了第4章 血色休书
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“飞哥，你快走！
这里让我来挡着就行！”
周木突然脸色大变，焦急地把叶云飞往场外推出去。
只不过，叶云飞腰身挺直，站立如山，他哪里推得动半分。
“周木，相信我。”
叶云飞望着满脸焦急的周木，露出灿烂而温暖的笑脸。
然后，叶云飞缓缓转身，笑容隐去，目光冰寒得犹如千年冰窖。
“叶云飞，我有话要跟你说。
你听着！”
这个时候，一直不出声的施小蝶，终于说话了。
她望向叶云飞的眼神，充满厌恶。
叶云飞是她的未婚夫，以前，叶云飞曾为她带来巨大的好处，她以叶云飞为荣，现在，她只想快点和这个废人撇清关系。
她觉得，自己的人生，绝对不能，浪费在一个废物身上！
“施小蝶，你这个贱人，先闭嘴。
等我跟他们算完账，自然会跟你算。”
叶云飞冷冷说道。
贱人？
施小蝶，不由得一愣，然后脸上闪现恼怒之色。
记忆中，叶云飞还是第一次，用贱人这个词来称呼她。
要知道，以前，叶云飞对她可是十分依顺，呵护备至。

可是，现在，叶云飞居然连正眼也不看她一眼，就算偶尔扫向她的目光，也是充满了厌恶。
“小蝶师姐，这个废物敢这么嚣张，不如等我先把他打残了再说。”
秦风狞笑道。
施小蝶没有说话，算是默认，她望向叶云飞的目光，更加冷漠了。
一个废物而已，嘴再硬，又能怎么样。
很快，他就会认清现实的了！
在武者的世界，实力才是最重要的，没有实力，就注定了，是垃圾，低人一等，任人踩踏！
施小蝶用一种居高临下的目光，扫视叶云飞，那美貌冷傲的脸容之上，露出不屑之色。
“敢动我叶云飞的兄弟，你将付出无法想象的代价。”
叶云飞冷漠的眼神，望向秦风，声音森冷得像是从九幽地狱传递上来。
“废物！
就凭你吗。
一个没有武脉的废物，也敢说这样的话，也不撒泡尿照照你的脸！”
秦风厉声喝斥道。
他觉得，刚才叶云飞能挡下他的那一脚，只不过是侥幸。
一个没有武脉的废物而已，没有什么好怕的。
“惨了，这个废物，免不了要捱一顿狠揍了。
估计等会要被人抬回去叶家了。”
此时，四周围，里外三层，围满看热闹的学员。
“听说，施小蝶早就和高级班的秦安师兄搞上了，已经公开出双入对。

不过，她居然亲自带着秦家的人来打自己的未婚夫，有点过份了。”
“嘿嘿，有什么过份，一个不能修为的废物，你以为，施小蝶会甘心嫁给他吗。
她早就恨不得这个废物早点死掉。”
content_en:
“Brother Fei, leave quickly!
Just let me block it here! "
Zhou Mu's expression suddenly changed and he anxiously pushed Ye Yunfei out of the field.
However, Ye Yunfei's waist was straight and he stood as tall as a mountain. He could not move even half an inch.
"Zhou Mu, trust me."
Ye Yunfei looked at Zhou Mu with an anxious face, showing a bright and warm smile.
Then, Ye Yunfei slowly turned around, his smile disappeared, and his eyes were as cold as a thousand-year-old ice cellar.
"Ye Yunfei, I have something to tell you.
Listen! "
At this time, Shi Xiaodie, who had been silent, finally spoke.
She looked at Ye Yunfei with eyes full of disgust.
Ye Yunfei is her fiancé. In the past, Ye Yunfei has brought her huge benefits. She is proud of Ye Yunfei. Now, she just wants to get rid of this useless person quickly.
She felt that her life must not be wasted on a waste!
"Shi Xiaodie, you bitch, shut up first.
When I finish settling the accounts with them, I will naturally settle the accounts with you. "
Ye Yunfei said coldly.
Bitch?
Shi Xiaodie couldn't help but be stunned, and then a look of anger flashed on his face.
This was the first time in his memory that Ye Yunfei used the word bitch to call her.
You know, in the past, Ye Yunfei was very obedient and protective of her.
However, now, Ye Yunfei didn't even look at her, and even if he occasionally glanced at her, he was full of disgust.
"Senior Sister Xiaodie, this loser dares to be so arrogant. Why don't you wait until I cripple him first?"
Qin Feng said with a ferocious smile.
Shi Xiaodie didn't speak, which was regarded as acquiescence. She looked at Ye Yunfei with an even colder look.
He's just a waste, no matter how tough his mouth is, what can he do?
Soon, he will realize the reality!
In the world of warriors, strength is the most important thing. Without strength, you are destined to be trash, inferior to others, and allowed to be trampled on!
Shi Xiaodie glanced at Ye Yunfei with a condescending gaze, and there was a look of disdain on that beautiful, cold and arrogant face.
"If you dare to touch my brother Ye Yunfei, you will pay an unimaginable price."
Ye Yunfei looked at Qin Feng with cold eyes, and his voice was as cold as if it came from the Nine Nether Hell.
"Trash!
Just you?
A loser with no martial arts dares to say such things without peeing in your face! "
Qin Feng shouted sharply.
He felt that it was just a fluke that Ye Yunfei was able to block his kick just now.
He's just a loser with no martial arts, there's nothing to be afraid of.
“What a tragedy, this loser will inevitably get a severe beating.
It is estimated that he will be carried back to Ye's house later. "
At this time, there were students on three levels inside and outside who were watching the excitement.
"I heard that Shi Xiaodie has been having an affair with Senior Brother Qin An from the advanced class for a long time, and they have made their relationship public.
However, she actually brought people from the Qin family to beat her fiancé, which was a bit excessive. "
"Hey, what's too much? A useless person who can't cultivate, do you think Shi Xiaodie will be willing to marry him?
She had long wished that this good-for-nothing would die soon. "
